input.command:
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie && python3 -c "
import json

# Compute grammar_only Entity F1 using same logic as posthoc_filter.py (raw types, no normalization)
records = [json.loads(l) for l in open('outputs/docred_grammar_only.jsonl') if l.strip()]

ent_tp = ent_gold = ent_pred = 0
parse_failures = 0
for rec in records:
    parsed = rec.get('parsed_output')
    if parsed is None:
        parse_failures += 1
        continue
    gold_ents = rec.get('gold_entities', [])
    entities = parsed.get('entities', [])
    
    gold_ent_set = set((e['text'].lower().strip(), e['type']) for e in gold_ents)
    pred_ent_set = set((e.get('text', '').lower().strip(), e.get('type', '')) for e in entities)
    
    ent_tp += len(gold_ent_set & pred_ent_set)
    ent_gold += len(gold_ent_set)
    ent_pred += len(pred_ent_set)

p = ent_tp / ent_pred if ent_pred else 0
r = ent_tp / ent_gold if ent_gold else 0
f1 = 2*p*r/(p+r) if (p+r) > 0 else 0

print(f'Grammar-only Entity F1: {f1*100:.2f}%')
print(f'  Precision: {p*100:.2f}%, Recall: {r*100:.2f}%')
print(f'  TP={ent_tp}, Gold={ent_gold}, Pred={ent_pred}')
print(f'  Parse failures: {parse_failures}/{len(records)}')
print(f'  Total entities in grammar_only: {sum(len(r.get(\"parsed_output\", {}).get(\"entities\", []) if r.get(\"parsed_output\") else []) for r in records)}')
"
